title: add RAG agent templates and tool-calling quickstarts + docs site updates
author: Priya Shah
description: Adds a set of RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) agent templates, tool-calling examples, and quickstart guides to the docs site and examples repo. Motivation: provide opinionated, production-ready agent patterns for common developer workflows (QA over docs, ticket routing, DB query agents) and make it straightforward for users to try tool-calling with Redwood SDKs. Includes: 1) RAG agent templates (Python + TypeScript) with modular retriever/kb connectors, 2) tool-calling examples demonstrating function/tool schemas, tool sandbox & safety patterns, 3) docs site pages (quickstarts, API examples, architecture notes) and 4) small test harness and CI docs deploy tweaks. Checklist: [x] Add agent templates and examples to redwood-examples [x] Add docs quickstarts and architecture notes [x] Add unit-tests for examples and CI smoke tests [x] Update SDK snippets and README [x] Add Linear links and cross-reference to existing RAG evals. Related: Linear ENG-2104, DOCS-705. Preview: https://deploy-preview.redwood.docs/rag-agent-quickstarts (staging). Notes: kept templates minimal and well-documented to encourage copy/paste; large model-specific tuning left to follow-up RFC.
